text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! ♪ Hey Trainer, come here for a sec. ♪
choice_data_list: What's this all of a sudden?
What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh? Interested in what I have to say? Hehe, of course you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sooo, right when I was passing by the student council office…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Teio's been doing some noteworthy work recently, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can sense that she's identified her strengths, studied them, and used that to polish her running form.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What's this? You, handing out compliments? Her work must be truly noteworthy then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph… Even I can say something nice from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …And that's what I heard them say! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I task you with further increasing my many strengths! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe. If anyone can get the job done, it'll be you! Am I wrong?
